scope: This artifact closes ONE R1 gate: the companion rollback drill. It is not an R1 re-attestation and measures none of the other open gates. The current R1 attestation remains artifacts/governance/smc_r1_live_rollout_evidence_2026-08-01.json.
supersedesNothing: The 2026-08-01 R1 evidence still records rollback.status = not_run, captured at 05:05:15Z. That was true when it was measured -- no implementation existed at that hour. It is deliberately NOT edited to match this later measurement, under the same rule that keeps the 2026-07-29 artifact byte-exact: a dated measurement is repeated by a new artifact, never rewritten.

drill.whyTheReloadsMatter: Both halves cross a hard page.goto. An in-session read proves only that the UI accepted a click -- it was green throughout the 2026-07-25 incident. The removal half additionally settles on the producer before reading absence, because on a chart whose legend has not been rebuilt yet 'absent' is indistinguishable from 'not drawn' and the assertion would pass on a layout that still carried both companions.

firstAttempt.outcome: removal passed, restore failed four times, layout left without both companions
firstAttempt.marketState: 2026-08-01 was a Saturday; US equity markets were closed for the whole degraded window.
firstAttempt.cause: The restore drove addExistingScriptToChartViaIndicators. Its row locator reported no visible candidate, it fell back to the keyboard, and that dialog does not commit on Enter -- its footer button reads 'Select'. Four insertions never happened and each was still reported as ok.

repair.independentVerdict: 9/9 consumers checked, 0 mismatches, 0 failures, no mutations; SMC Event Overlay 1/1 and SMC Exit Signal 9/9 bindings

fixes: #4309 -- restore through refreshChartScriptInstance (Pine editor, force-insert), read presence back off the chart, and check both companions are present BEFORE rebinding so a failed insertion does not surface as a binding fault
#4309 -- r1_restore_companions / TV_DRILL_RESTORE_ONLY, because the full drill dies in its baseline precondition when the companions are already missing, which is before its recovery block is armed

#4310 -- the repair step runs on save-step failure too; with the companions missing the verification ahead of it reports 'Existing chart instance not found' and fails, so the repair was skipped by exactly the damage it was dispatched for

remainingOpenGates: Hold Manager exclusivity and Simple Management layout inventory
